landing.heroHeadline: Ship, hold, or roll back — decided with evidence.
landing.heroSub: One place to run release decisions, investigate regressions down to the session, and track whether your AI's failure detection is actually getting better — for commerce, support, or any agent product.
landing.featuresHeading: Everything a release decision actually needs
landing.featureReleaseBody: SHIP, HOLD, or ROLLBACK — with the primary metric movement, guardrail status, and business impact that produced the call, not just the verdict.
landing.featureInvestigationBody: Drill from an aggregate regression straight to the segment, mechanism, and representative sessions actually driving it.
landing.featureAIQualityBody: Offline benchmark quality and real human-review quality, side by side — confirmation rates, confusion pairs, and drift over detector versions.
landing.featureReviewBody: Confirm, reject, or correct what your detectors flagged. Review never silently changes production behavior — it feeds a measurable quality loop.
landing.ctaHeading: Set up your first project in minutes
landing.ctaSub: No JSON, no API calls — a guided setup gets your metrics, guardrails, and data connected.

overview.noExperiments: No experiments found for this project yet.
overview.noPrimaryMetric: This project doesn't have a primary metric configured yet, so there's no north-star signal to show here.
overview.flatInconclusive: {{metric}} is broadly flat / inconclusive at the aggregate level (not statistically significant).
overview.guardrailBreachedSummary: A guardrail is breached ({{names}}), which on its own is enough to block a ship decision regardless of the north star.
overview.needsSegmentInvestigation: This is exactly the kind of case that needs segment-level investigation rather than a snap judgment from the aggregate numbers.

experiment.randomizationUnitValue: User (each user sees exactly one version for the life of the experiment)
experiment.metricComparisonSub: Every number is computed server-side; statistical detail is available per row.
experiment.funnelSub: Ordered stages this domain's sessions pass through.
experiment.guardrailsSub: Latency, cost, and error checks that can block a ship decision regardless of the north star.

investigation.title: Investigation
investigation.subtitle: Where is the regression concentrated, and what behavior is associated with it?
investigation.excessContributionSub: Which segment(s) actually drive the regression — magnitude and direction, most-significant first.
investigation.noSegmentPassed: No segment passed correction and minimum-effect-size filtering for this metric.
investigation.noPrimaryMetricConfigured: This project has no primary metric configured yet, and none was requested — configure one in Project Setup to run an investigation.

findingCard.noSegmentPassedFilters: No segment passed the significance and minimum-effect-size filters for this metric.
findingCard.headline: v2's change in {{metric}} is concentrated in {{segment}}.

mechanismPanel.associationalOnly: Associational evidence only — never a causal claim for post-treatment behavior.
mechanismPanel.nonConversationalBody: This segment's regression is associated with an Android-platform latency regression, not a conversational failure mode.
mechanismPanel.guardrailStatus: The experiment-wide p95 latency guardrail is {{status}} (v1 {{v1}}ms vs v2 {{v2}}ms).
mechanismPanel.nonConversationalFooter: The classifier's dominant failure-mode label below (if any) is a secondary, incidental conversational-taxonomy signal for this segment — it does not explain the regression. Open the affected sessions to see real per-session latency.
mechanismPanel.tooSmallToAttribute: Total excess abandonment in this segment is too small to attribute a reliable per-mode share.
mechanismPanel.sharesNote: Shares may exceed 100% or be negative (offsetting contributions) — not clamped or renormalized. Abandonment: v1 {{v1}} → v2 {{v2}}.
mechanismPanel.noTrajectoryPattern: No trajectory pattern reached the minimum session count in this segment.
mechanismPanel.experimentWideContextSub: Not segment-specific — shown for context on the kind of behavior associated with v2 overall.

releaseDecision.evaluatingHint: Recomputing statistics and guardrails — this can take up to a minute.
releaseDecision.noEvaluationYet: No release evaluation has been run yet for this experiment.
releaseDecision.underlyingVerdict: Underlying verdict: {{verdict}} (withheld due to data quality) ·
releaseDecision.verdictHistorySub: Is today's regression new, or has it been persistent across repeated evaluations?
releaseDecision.noEconomicsConfig: This domain has no economics configuration.
releaseDecision.businessImpactUnavailable: Business impact is unavailable (revenue/value data not ingested).
releaseDecision.shipWithheld: A SHIP verdict was withheld because project data quality is critical.
releaseDecision.manualEvaluation: Manual evaluation — full history, no time window.
releaseDecision.noEvidence: No notable evidence beyond the primary metric itself.

mockClassifierBanner.title: Deterministic mock classifier (CI-safe stand-in), not a real LLM.
mockClassifierBanner.body: All failure-mode labels and precision/recall numbers on this page come from a rule-based mock ({{version}}), used so the pipeline is testable without an API key. This is not real LLM classification quality — a real LLM evaluation is planned before final portfolio release.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Drill from a statistical finding into concrete session examples.

sessionDetail.detectedMechanismsSub: A session can have zero, one, or several — mechanisms are not mutually exclusive.
sessionDetail.timelineSub: User/agent transcript, action sequence, and tool calls for this session — no chain-of-thought.
sessionDetail.noTranscript: No transcript recorded for this session.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Fired automatically when a release evaluation rolls back, breaches a blocking guardrail, or holds on a negative segment.

reviewQueue.title: Review queue
reviewQueue.subtitle: Confirm, reject, or correct what the detectors flagged — human review never changes the original detection, only adds a reviewed decision alongside it.
reviewQueue.nothingToReview: Nothing to review — no detected attributions match these filters.
reviewQueue.newVersionTooltip: This item is on the newest detector/model/prompt version introduced for this mechanism.

projectOverview.title: Project overview
projectOverview.noExperimentsYet: No experiments in this project yet.

aiQuality.title: AI Quality
aiQuality.subtitle: Model/agent behavior quality, independent of the business funnel.
aiQuality.lowSampleTooltip: Fewer than the minimum reviewed sample for a reliable rate.
aiQuality.failureMechanismPrevalenceSub: Share of sessions where each mechanism's detector fired — mechanisms can overlap, so rates do not sum to 100%.
aiQuality.noRegisteredMechanisms: This domain has no registered failure mechanisms.
aiQuality.humanReviewQualitySub: What reviewers actually decided about detected attributions in THIS project — distinct from the offline benchmark below, which is measured against held-out ground truth, not real production judgment.
aiQuality.noAttributionsReviewed: No attributions have been reviewed yet for this experiment — see the Review Queue.
aiQuality.confidenceBucketHeading: Confirmation rate by original detector confidence
aiQuality.confidenceBucketSub: A well-calibrated detector confirms more often at higher confidence — a flat or inverted pattern is worth investigating.
aiQuality.qualityOverTime: Quality over time, by detector version
aiQuality.qualityOverTimeSub: Chronological (first-seen) — a drop right after a version change is a visible regression.
aiQuality.trajectorySummariesSub: Descriptive frequency + outcome rate — not a statistically-tested Investigation finding.
aiQuality.noTrajectoryPattern: No trajectory pattern met the minimum session count.
aiQuality.hybridEvaluationSub: Held-out benchmark of the CURRENT architecture — deterministic detectors + one semantic LLM call per session — against independent multi-label ground truth, NOT real reviewer decisions (see "Human review quality" above for that). See AI_EVALUATION.md §5.
aiQuality.semanticCall: Semantic call (one LLM request per session)
aiQuality.legacyClassifierEvaluationSub: Deprecated architecture — kept only for historical comparison. See "Hybrid attribution evaluation" above for the current pipeline.

status.title: Setup readiness
status.subtitle: What's configured, what's missing, and what's actively blocking analysis right now.
status.noDataSource: No data source is connected yet -- nothing can be analyzed
status.noPrimaryMetric: No primary metric is set -- release decisions cannot be evaluated
status.guardrailActive: At least one guardrail is active
status.noGuardrails: No guardrails are configured -- risky changes could ship unflagged

status.dataQualityWarning: Data quality has warnings worth reviewing
status.monitoringNotSetUp: Scheduled monitoring is not set up

project.subtitle: Choose which project you're configuring, or create a new one. Each project belongs to one domain and holds its own metrics, guardrails, and data.
project.noOrgYet: You don't belong to an organization yet -- create one to hold your projects.

dataSource.subtitle: Where this project's session data comes from, and whether it's flowing.
dataSource.ingestionDescription: This project can accept session data. New sessions can be sent to the ingestion API directly, imported from Langfuse traces, or enriched from a Postgres business database -- whichever fits your stack.
dataSource.sessionsReceivedDescription: At least one session has been recorded for this project.
dataSource.noSessionsDescription: No sessions have arrived yet. Metrics, guardrails, and release decisions all depend on real session data being ingested first.
dataSource.selectProject: Select a project to see its data-source status.

metrics.primaryMetricSubtitle: The one metric release decisions are judged on. Must be one of this project's inferential metrics.
metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.customized: This project has a customized metric list.

guardrails.subtitle: Automatic checks that can block a ship decision when a metric moves too far in the wrong direction.

segments.subtitle: Which fields from your session data should be explored when investigating a regression -- picked from fields already seen in your data.
segments.noFields: No context fields have been seen in ingested data yet. Send some sessions with context data, then come back here.
segments.errorAtLeastOne: {{field}}: enter at least one allowed value (comma-separated) or unselect this dimension

economics.subtitle: Optional. Map columns from your ingested data so release decisions can show a cost/value impact -- leave blank to skip.
economics.note: Economics will stay unavailable on release decisions until a success column is mapped here and your ingested sessions actually contain that column.
economics.errorSuccessRequired: success_column: required when an economics mapping is provided

monitoring.schedulingSubtitle: How often each experiment is automatically re-evaluated, and over what data window.
monitoring.noExperiments: No experiments exist yet for this project.
monitoring.notificationEventsSubtitle: Which events should trigger a notification through this project's configured channels.
monitoring.channelsSubtitle: Where notifications are sent. A channel's full URL is only ever shown once, right after you create it.

review.subtitle: A summary of what's configured for this project. Come back to any step above at any time to change it.
